note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A), ER-36 applied (5X/6C). Every assert is derived by hand from the 20-wire topology and the printed rule (p.30 Morse code C: dash dot dash dot, Q: dash dash dot dash; light 5 = dash, light 6 = dot), not printed against dial positions. Topology: pushbutton 6 (6Y on + via 6H/6Y, 6H/6+) puts + on 6X/6G/6F; relay 6 pulls in through 6F-coil-6E-lamp-6C(-) and holds through 6H-6G; 6F feeds D17 (RUN, D18/M-) and the wiper D16. Light 5 (5A, 5B/5-) is on D3, D5, D8, D9, D11; light 6 (6A, 6B/6-) on D4, D6, D10; D0-D2, D7 and D12-D15 are unwired, so the call reads - . - . (D3-D6), letter space (D7), - - . - (D8-D11). Each sequence until pairs the dial contact with its lamp and has a maxMs below one revolution, so a lamp on the wrong contact fails. Off asserts are taken only on the long dark run (D14), never just after a lit contact, because a lamp cools through dim (O-C28). Pushbutton 5 under ER-36 joins + (5Y) to - (6C) and trips the breaker (O-C9); that is the stop asserted here. The dial position after the trip depends on the coast fallback (O-R5) and is not asserted. The 5X/6E clean-stop variant is a separate derivation. Rotary geometry, run rate and coast remain profile fallbacks O-R1, O-R3 and O-R5.
